list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden

sources.exophase: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5): official trophy names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags
sources.note: Every guide below is our own advice, read from the official trophy description. GTA 6 released 19 Nov 2026, so exact in-game spots are not yet verified in play; where a place is not pinned down, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list: PSN progress counts (for example 42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Leave the long grinds for last — gold medals at the Shooting Range, 250 stunts and 100% completion — and work the roadmap in this guide stage by stage.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed — play the intro through and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1's story missions in order until the chapter closes. Unmissable: every story mission counts, so just keep following the main path.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions in order until the chapter closes. Unmissable, like the other chapter trophies — the story carries you to it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3's story missions in order until the chapter closes. Unmissable — finish the chapter and it is yours.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4's story missions in order until the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it is unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the gold story trophy and it is unmissable — but before you start it, clear any one-time moments flagged as missable in this guide, in case the finale locks them out.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story; if you somehow fail a step, retry the mission — story missions can be replayed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the main story, so it comes to you — complete it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It is a named story mission, so follow the main path until it appears, then complete it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. A named story mission — it unlocks in the main story's order, so keep playing through.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It is a main-story mission, so it arrives in order — complete it to earn this.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named late-story mission — play the main story through to it and complete it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats. That means the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles in this guide — use the in-game checklist to find what is left, and save this gold for the very end of the run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, in free roam or missions. Farm them in one open stretch of road with a fast bike once the story is done; the count is cumulative, so every stunt you ever land counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races and the rest. If one type is missing from your count, open the activities menu and look for the type you have never tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSN counts 42). Work through them range by range with your best weapons, and retry a challenge at once when you miss gold — the range lets you repeat them freely, so this is a grind, not a missable.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its 14 locations (PSN counts 14). Learn one course at a time and keep your racing line tight; a win at every spot is what counts, not a single fast time.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix street races, off-road and any other race type the map offers, and tick each new win off in the checklist here.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Fishing challenges are an activity, so find Cal at a fishing spot and take the challenge — bring your best rod and watch the line, not the clock.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk into an arcade and finish one full arcade game. Any machine counts — pick the game you are best at and play it to its end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand to its last mission. Stranger strands appear as side missions across Leonida — follow Andy's chain to the end and this pops with the final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand to its last mission. Follow Kenton's chain of side missions to the end; the trophy comes with the final one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand to its last mission. Track Billy's side missions across the map and play the chain through to its finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more stranger chains and finish those too. This silver is the reward for doing the stranger content properly, not just one chain.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand to its last mission. Follow Randy's chain to its final mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its last mission. Follow Tyrone's chain of side missions to its end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (PSN counts 18). These are quiet scenic spots on the map — visit each one and meditate there; use the in-game map markers to find the ones you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is a stranger strand mission for Bret — follow his chain and the hunt itself; bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly, since a unique animal is unlikely to give you a second chance on the same day.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them as you explore and trade or find the missing ones; three full sets is the silver, so keep every card you find.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a long one — do a few spots in every area you visit during the story instead of leaving all 100 for the end, and the count builds up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges — the small goals listed in the challenges menu, from driving feats to combat tasks. Work through the easy ones first and let the harder ones come as you play; the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. This is a single co-op moment: pick a quiet stretch of road, rack up the heat together, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. If the moment passes, retry it in free roam with your partner.
trophies.missableNote: A single co-op moment — do it with your partner in free roam before the finale, and retry there if it fails.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving. One clean run is all it takes.
trophies.missableNote: One clean run with your partner — plan the three-shop route first, then do it in a single attempt.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — sit in, drive or otherwise register each new vehicle you come across. The count grows as you explore: try every car, bike, boat and truck you see, and check the vehicle list to see what you still miss.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus once and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a busy fight, wait until enemies group up, then activate it and chain the takedowns fast — accuracy matters more than speed here.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the description points at a specific stunt-like exit from the airport. Try it in free roam at the airport: grab a fast vehicle or aircraft and make your own departure. If one attempt fails, the airport is always there to retry.
trophies.missableNote: A single airport moment — try it in free roam at VCIA; the exact exit is not yet verified, so treat the first try as a scouting run.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks — in whatever the game throws at you. The trophy's description is a joke, not a manual: expect a Rhino encounter in a mission or in free roam at high wanted levels, and survive it. The exact trigger is not yet verified in play.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a Rhino moment that may only come once — keep a save before any mission that fields tanks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without any detection. Go in quiet, move slowly, and leave before the alarm — stealth gear and patience beat speed. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so scout the store first and retry.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the bigger heists of the free-roam crime loop — plan the getaway before you go in, and do them one at a time across your playthrough.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and escape with the take. Trucks run set routes around the map — intercept one, stop it, grab the cash and break away from the wanted level before it builds.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida (PSN counts 52). Drive, fly and walk the whole map — the count fills as you uncover each named area, so combine it with the story, the WAiNK spots and the vehicle hunting.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs in Leonida (PSN counts 9). Gangs hold different corners of the map — find each gang's operation, hit it, and escape. Work through the gang list one by one and tick them off here.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order and enjoy a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet one-time moment on the beachfront — find a beach bar on Ocean Beach, sit with the view, and order the drink. Do it before the finale, just in case the moment is tied to the story's mood.
trophies.missableNote: A single beachfront moment — do it early, before the final mission, so it cannot be locked out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive straight through a vehicle showroom and smash your way out in classic style. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and go through the glass — the trophy is about the exit, so make it loud and make it count.
trophies.missableNote: A single showroom moment — once the showroom is smashed it may not reset, so save first if you can.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end. Bowling is an activity, so head to that alley, bowl the game out, and the trophy pops at the final frame.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description points at a story beat where the partnership lands in front of a crowd. Play the story and watch for the public moment; the exact scene is not yet verified, so this guide flags it rather than guessing the mission.
trophies.missableNote: A story-beat moment that may only happen once — keep a save before late-story partnership scenes.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choices the game tracks — PSN counts progress toward 500 for this one, so choices add up across the whole game. Pick your path in dialogue and story decisions as they come; there is no single right answer, only the count.
trophies.missableNote: Choices accumulate across the game — decide deliberately in story moments, since a choice cannot be unmade.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try — the description says it all. Some attempt in the game fails the first time and works the second; when something goes wrong, try it again right away instead of reloading an old save, because the second attempt is the point.
trophies.missableNote: A second-try moment — if you fail something, retry it at once instead of reloading, or the trigger may pass.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's weird-moment trophy. Keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida: odd events, easter eggs and surprises count. The exact trigger is not yet verified, so explore widely and let it find you.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off strange event — it may only trigger once, so explore off the beaten path and keep saves.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a target on foot, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up cleanly.
trophies.missableNote: A single drive-by moment — it can be retried in free roam, but it needs a clean setup, so do it deliberately.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — feed them to your laundering contacts steadily instead of hoarding them, and the total adds up across the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars and everything else. It counts cumulatively, so normal shopping across the whole playthrough gets you most of the way; finish it off with a big purchase at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties (PSN counts 8). Garages are properties you purchase around the map — save up, buy them as you find them, and keep the last one for when your money is flush late in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, bring them into the app and register them — ten different ones. Mix cars and bikes you find while exploring, and the count fills up.
trophies.name: On the Spot
